events.title: Patch Notes v0.6.20
events.summary: 🔧 Bug Fixes- Fixed a bug where bosses could become invulnerable again when taking damage from status effect ticks.- Fixed an issue where older save files could retain outdated Meta Tree upgrades, affecting EXP and Gold gain as well as initial player stats.⚠️ Note: Some Breakers' recent runs using older save files may not accurately reflect the current game balance due to outdated Meta Tree bonuses. This issue has been fixed in the latest patch.

events.title: 📣 What’s actually in the Shardbreakers Demo?
events.summary: The Demo takes place in one biome, but each run can play out pretty differently. You’ll travel through a branching map and decide which rooms to visit along the way - from Normal and Elite encounters to Shops, Reforge, and other special rooms. The route you take will affect the opportunities you have to shape your build before reaching the end of the run, where you’ll face the Boss.You’ll have 3 classes to choose from: Hunter, Knight, and Arcanist. events.title: Shardbreakers Has Changed - Come Play It With Us
events.summary: Over the past months, we've reworked some of the biggest parts of Shardbreakers. Through all of those changes, we kept coming back to one idea:We want you to design your magic, not just collect upgrades.What’s changed?The Fusion system has been replaced by Resonance. Socket Shards together to create chains of spells, then rearrange them to change how your engine works. events.title: Demo Temporarily Offline for a Major Rework
events.summary: We will be taking the demo down soon to rework the core combat and spellcrafting experience.Our goal is simple: Improve the build so it feels immediately responsive, readable, and satisfying from the first minutes of play.The next demo version will focus on:Clearer spell interactionsStronger visual feedbackMore consistent build identity early in a runThe demo will return in a much stronger state. We will share an update when it is ready ⚡

events.title: DEMO UPDATE #02
events.summary: Main Menu: Added a Demo Info section.Elite Loot: Elites can now drop rare materials (meta currency).Skill Fix: Fixed a bug that occurred when switching to empty or cooling-down skill slots.Boss Fix: Cleaned up “invisible obstacles” left behind by Zone 2 boss attacks.Make sure to update to enjoy the latest version of the Demo! Thank you for playing!

events.title: DEMO UPDATE #01
events.summary: This quick update focuses on small improvements to enhance the overall player experience.Fixed the bug where Dash sometimes doesn't work if FPS is too high (300fps).Improve the visibility and response time of Spike Traps.Rebalance the health stats of some Elites and Bosses.Rebalance the weapon stats of Hunter.Adjusted the behavior of Zone 2's Boss (reduced difficulty).And some minor bug fixes.Make sure to update to enjoy the latest version of the game!Thank you for playing!
